notes.title: Armor Suits Update - v0.02.000
notes.notes:
[h3]The final unique feature of the game is now available : Armor Suits for Units![/h3]

The first 4 are available now :

[b]Runner suit[/b]
A cheap suit made for handgun holders, it provides some armor but ultimately increases the move speed of the unit.

[b]Juggernaut suit[/b]
As the name implies, a suit made to increase sustain. Provides a lot of armor but reduces significantly the unit move speed.

[b]Deflective suit[/b]
A great defensive armor that will give the unit a chance to negate incoming damages. Cheap, provides bit of armor, and only reduces the unit move speed a bit.

[b]Energy suit[/b]
The best base suit for offensive units. Provides a bit of armor and does not reduce that much the unit move speed, but has the ability to temporarily double the unit damages.

[h3]Each suit grants a passive skill unlocking when the unit reaches level 3 :[/h3]

[b]Tactical Sprint[/b] (Runner Suit) :
[i]- Increases move speed by 20% of the unit base move speed when a handgun is equiped.[/i]
[b]Core Expand[/b] (Juggernaut suit) : 
[i]- Increases health points by 75.[/i]
[b]Energy Dispersion[/b] (Deflective suit) : 
[i]- Dodge 15% of incoming damages.[/i]
[b]Plasma Bank[/b] (Energy suit) :
[i]- Get a secondary energy bank that fills up over time and can be spent to double the damages of the current weapon. Shooting consumes equivalent to twice the damages dealt as energy.[/i]

notes.title: Equipment Update - v0.01.018
notes.notes:
I've been working for a long time on a highly community requested feature : A better way to equip units with weapons and suits. And here it is!

A brand new structure acting as an equipment hub, the [b]Equipment Crate[/b], allows you to store all armories productions and to equip large groups of units in seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45405081/34bbea2fddd279dd1a6278ff3f7299e6c36ba1f8.gif[/img]

Also another highly requested feature : [b]Tactical Pause[/b]

You can now enable and disable Tactical Pause at anytime by pressing Space which allows you to slow down game speed to 4% to regroup your army and ramp up production while in combat.

notes.title: Leveling Update - v0.01.001
notes.notes:
One of the main feature of the game is now available : [b]Units leveling[/b]

Each unit individually levels up, up to level 10, and gains bonus base stats for each level.
For each level your units get bonus health, damage, armor, fire rate, and move speed. They also gain all their health back upon leveling up.

They don't have to participate in a kill to gain experience, all they have to do is be around when an enemy unit is destroyed. That way even support units can level up.

notes.title: Demo is available!
notes.notes:
The first demo version of Frontier Control: Invasion is now [b]available[/b]!

This is the first playable version and a lot of content is still to be added. It features the first 5 enemies, 4 weapons, all low tech structures and the first boss. Slowly adding new content throughout the development of the game will help a lot with the balance in my opinion.

It might be a bit early to release but balancing the game is already a challenge and I think it will eventually lead to a better outcome for the final game.

With some systems missing like leveling for units or armor suits, the game is currently quite hard according to the first feedback I got from testers. No difficulty setting is yet available (coming soon), but it is well possible to reach the end of the demo.

After dozens of hours playing the game, testers have not encountered any game breaking bugs. However a bug report panel is available in the main menu and I strongly recommend players to report anything they find suspicious or any feedback about the game itself like balance for example.

The demo will be updated every week with new content, features, and patches to fix found bugs.

Today starts a journey towards the release of the full game in 2026 and I hope to find you among the people who come to enjoy the game.
